content: We need to state the count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no description of the molecule. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve NMR spectra and infer aromatic carbons count. But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the sample is implicit? Could be that the environment has a sample at hand (the "sample at hand") and we can run carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count aromatic carbon signals. Let's try to get carbon NMR.
